categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp with the P2P label, modifying network socket event handling and peer disconnection logic.
categories.rationale: Prevents an unread TCP urgent pointer from causing a busy loop in the network event loop on POSIX platforms. According to commit 1fde57f1de, TCP urgent data leaves select's exception set pending on non-Windows platforms, which can spin the event loop continuously.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: The 3-line edit to src/util/sock.cpp strictly follows from the networking event loop changes and is not an independent utility improvement.
categories.rationale: Not a utilities change; changes in sock.cpp are auxiliary to P2P socket event handling.
